evidence: Carries the Wallet label and modifies `src/wallet/rpc/encrypt.cpp` along with numerous wallet functional tests.
rationale: Deprecates an error-prone wallet workflow that poses serious risks to key privacy, backup validity, and descriptor spending conditions. As noted in the description, encrypting existing wallets 'leaves unencrypted private key remnants on disk', generates new keys that risk fund loss when restoring from older backups, and can 'change the spending conditions out from under the user (#26607)'.
